semantic_boundary:
# Independent contract, recorded before reading grading code

Streaming: A repeated new-request record with the same request ID continues the existing GPUModelRunner session, without duplicate or stale persistent-batch rows. Each record is the complete prompt for the new segment, and its output buffer starts empty, including when only part of previous output is absorbed. Token prompts, embedding prompts, multimodal/M-RoPE metadata, sampling and pooling parameters, blocks and computed-token state must match the new segment across repeated and interleaved sessions; unrelated sessions and ordinary new requests remain correct. Scope is production runner state updates, not the full API/scheduler stack or model inference. Implementation layout is unrestricted.

Modular MoE: Each modular factory, kernel profiling path and affected backend follows its active layer’s MoE parallel configuration, independently of conflicting, changed or absent ambient/other-layer configuration. Without layer config compatibility construction is non-DP+EP and needs no global config. DP+EP profiling reserves worst-case workspace under the existing 16384-token chunk bound, even for small local inputs; an ordinary layer retains ordinary requirements despite ambient DP+EP. Preserve actual single-rank Triton numerical behavior; non-modular functional paths must not acquire generic global parallel-config dependence. Constructor names, storage and shape-query counts are not contract requirements.

Environment identities and resource boundaries were read from task.toml and Dockerfiles. Streaming is a CPU state-lifecycle task; Modular requires a single A100 GPU. Neither implies complete distributed model serving coverage.
